mainEntity.name: Why does remote-work continuity matter in a nomad residency matter?

acceptedAnswer.text: In client terms, work and business routes depend on the real activity in Brazil, the structure around it, and documents that match the proposed purpose closely. In real cases, remote-work continuity changes route fit, documents, and timing. No public explanation can replace a review of the actual file.
